HEADLINE: Starlit Power Systems Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 03/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulations ....
MORE:
Starlit Power Systems Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 03/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Pursuant to Regulations 29 and 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the meeting of the Board of Directors of Starlit Power Systems Ltd commenced today i.e. on 02nd November, 2026 at 05:00 P.M. and concluded at 05:20 P.M. to consider and approve, inter alia, the unaudited (Standalone and consolidated) Financial Results of the Company along with the Limited Review Report for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.
Due to ongoing deliberations and pending conclusion of agenda items, the meeting has been continued and
shall reconvene on 03rd November, 2026 at 05:00 P.M. at the registered office of the Company to consider and approve the aforesaid financial results and other related matters.
The Board Meeting shall be deemed to have commenced on 03rd November, 2026 and will conclude on completion of the business items on the reconvened date.
